title: Baazigar
desc: Jayalalitha J (Jayaram) was a member of India's Council of States elected from Tamil Nadu for the 1984-1989 mandate. Jayalalithaa who is called 'amma' (mother) by her followers, proclaimed herself as political heir of the late leader of the opposition, Ramachandra.

title: Meet Mere Man Ke
desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man of high principles falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her. However, the difference in their social statuses threatens to maim his plans.

title: Hum
desc: Enraged by his father's death at the hands of Bakhtawar, Tiger vows to murder him but Inspector Giridhar stops him. Later, Giridhar steals from Bakhtawar and kills his family but blames Tiger for it.

title: Dastaan
desc: Vishnu, a reputed judge, is assumed to be Anil, an absconding murderer. However, he decides to travel to Anil's home town and unravel the mystery behind his lookalike's existence.
